findings.text: Reviewer F1 reproduced and NOT repaired here: the shipped client cannot start or complete a diagnosis (nor archive/restore a company). src/api/httpClient.ts request() sets Content-Type only when a body exists; server/http/requestGuards.ts requireJsonWrites answers 415 json_required to every POST/PUT/PATCH without application/json. Probe with the real httpClient against the real createApp: POST /api/companies/:id/diagnoses -> 415 json_required, POST /api/companies/:id/archive -> 415 json_required, the same start with 'content-type: application/json' -> 201. Neither file is in this unit's allowed files. The guard is right to demand the header (a no-cors cross-site POST sends no Content-Type and needs no preflight), so the repair belongs in the client. I did not leave a red test: 'pnpm test -- <file>' runs the whole vitest suite, so a failing test here would turn every sibling unit's verification red; the cross-lane wiring is integration's.

Reviewer F2 fixed: readStoredAnswers/readStoredCalculator no longer return {} when one stored key stops validating. A shared readAnswer() now validates one answer for both the PATCH schema and the stored read; the stored read keeps every valid key and leaves out only the leftover (question removed from the bank, value out of range); the calculator is read key by key through calculatorPatchSchema.shape. Only a row that is not an object at all reads as empty. A leftover key therefore no longer makes the next autosave write the readable answers away. spendParts stays whole-or-nothing. Red first (f2-red.log, exit 1), green after.

Reviewer F3 unchanged on purpose: POST /api/companies/:id/diagnoses still creates a draft for an archived company, because the PRD has no rule for it and inventing one is a product decision. Recommendation if the owner wants it closed: refuse only the creation of a new draft with 409 company_archived (an existing draft keeps being returned), a few lines in diagnosisRepository.startDraft plus one test.
'pnpm test -- tests/api/diagnosisRoutes.test.ts' runs the whole vitest suite (pnpm forwards a literal '--'): 10 files / 566 tests passed. The unit's file alone has 72 tests, all green.

The 422 incomplete body puts pendingBlocks beside code/message (error.pendingBlocks) while httpClient keeps only error.details; src/api/diagnosesApi.ts compensates by re-reading the draft and running pendingBlocks() (one extra GET). It works; passing the list through httpClient would remove the extra call.
Not run: pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/questionnaire.spec.ts (AC-dm-12/14/16/17/48 on screen). It needs the frontend units and the integration build; outside this unit.
Not run: AC-dm-27 timing of 'Calculando o seu diagnóstico' (target 3 s) in the Play. It needs the running Play and the integration build.
Not run: aioson harness:check . --slug=diagnostico-maturidade. Not part of this unit's Done-when; it needs the integration build.

messages.text: CRITICAL, needed before this capability works in the running app: src/api/httpClient.ts request() must send 'Content-Type: application/json' on every POST/PUT/PATCH, with or without a body (today: if (hasBody) headers['Content-Type'] = ...). Suggested edit: const isWrite = method === 'POST' || method === 'PUT' || method === 'PATCH'; if (hasBody || isWrite) headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'. Do NOT relax requireJsonWrites: a no-cors cross-site POST has no Content-Type and no preflight, so the guard is what stops it. Affected body-less calls today: diagnosesApi.startDiagnosis (POST /api/companies/:id/diagnoses), diagnosesApi.completeDiagnosis (POST /api/diagnoses/:id/complete), companiesApi.archiveCompany and restoreCompany (POST .../archive, .../restore). No change is needed on the server side of this unit; the tests already send the header on every write, so they stay green before and after. After the edit, run the questionnaire and company e2e specs, which are the first real exercise of these POSTs.

Until httpClient sends the header itself, src/api/diagnosesApi.ts startDiagnosis and completeDiagnosis get 415 from the server. If you prefer not to wait for the shared client fix, passing an empty object as body (httpClient.post(path, {})) makes the header go out; the routes ignore the body. The shared fix in httpClient is still the one that also covers archive/restore.

Open owner decision (recommended: yes): should POST /api/companies/:id/diagnoses refuse to create a NEW draft for an archived company (409 company_archived), still returning an existing draft? The PRD is silent, so the API currently allows it and only the UI hides 'Novo diagnóstico'. If yes it is a few lines in server/repositories/diagnosisRepository.ts startDraft plus a test; the frontend would need a message for that code.

Checks I could not run, for you to run after the build: (1) pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/questionnaire.spec.ts; (2) AC-dm-27: conclude a diagnosis in the Play and time 'Calculando o seu diagnóstico' until the result (target 3 s); (3) aioson harness:check . --slug=diagnostico-maturidade. Stored answers/calculator now read tolerantly (leftover keys are dropped, valid keys kept); no change to the IF-003 response shape.
